notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and no hardware run is claimed. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver are used unchanged (no card deviation): the upstream legacy Gym environment is served through the gymnasium bridge, which derives cap.world.step/reset/seed from its spaces. The upstream simulator path was not run: QuadrotorEnvironment is not registered with gymnasium.make, so env_id is None and no sim backend is declared, and package code never imports the clone. The fake (fake.py) is a pure Python re-implementation of the default QuadrotorModel dynamics, ModelDelayWrapper step, ToObservationMap and RewardFunction; gym, numpy and numpy-quaternion are not installed where the gate runs, so the fake was never compared with the upstream environment and trajectories can differ. The fake returns the full default 18-value observation (3 position, 3 velocity, 9 rotation-matrix, 3 angular-velocity values); no array is reduced. The fake accepts reset(seed=...) as an adapter convenience; the upstream reset has no seed argument and draws its initial state from numpy's global generator, so the seeded determinism claim covers the fake backend that is served, not an unrun upstream path. The driver declares no Limits: the only bounds are the bridge-derived action.values [-1, 1] per element from the upstream Box(-1, 1, (4,)) at quadrotor_environment/quadrotor_environment.py:132 and the ticks bound from max_ticks. Five warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only seeds the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for seed (twice), action.values and ticks, which the bridge derives without units. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
